entities.summary: Oswald Achenbach was a German painter associated with the Düsseldorf school of painting. During his lifetime, he was counted among the most important landscape painters of Europe. Through his teaching activities, he influenced the Kunstakademie Düsseldorf. His brother, Andreas Achenbach, who was twelve years older, was also among the most important German landscape painters of the 19th century. The two brothers were humorously called "the A and O of Landscapes". Oswald Achenbach was a writers & intellectuals from Düsseldorf (1827-02-02, Düsseldorf–1905-02-01). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
